# Google Chrome Browser Interface

## System and Window Information

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by "Activities" in top-left corner)
- **Application**: Google Chrome
- **Window Title**: "Google Chrome"
- **Date and Time**: Oct 22 20:27 (displayed in the top bar)
- **System Tray**: Located in the top-right corner, includes icons for network, sound, and power

## Browser Tabs

- **Total Tabs**: 5
- **Tab Titles**: 
  - "Notion"
  - "New Tab" (x4)
- **Active Tab**: The rightmost "New Tab"
- **Tab Management**: 
  - Tabs are arranged horizontally across the top
  - Each tab has a close button (x) on the right side
  - A "+" button is available to open a new tab

## Browser Toolbar

- **Navigation Buttons**: 
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
  - Refresh button
- **Address Bar**: 
  - Contains a "G" icon (Google) followed by a blinking cursor
  - A dropdown menu is open, showing:
    - "New Tab"
    - "chrome://newtab"
    - "Memory usage: 20.0 MB"
- **Right Side of Toolbar**:
  - Star icon (for bookmarking)
  - User profile icon
  - "Finish update" button
  - Three-dot menu button (for additional options)

## Main Content Area

- **Background**: White
- **Google Logo**: Centered, multicolored (blue, red, yellow, green)
- **Search Bar**: 
  - Placeholder text: "Search Google or type a URL"
  - Includes a magnifying glass icon on the left
  - Includes a microphone icon and a camera icon on the right
- **Shortcuts Section**: 
  - Three circular icons below the search bar:
    - "Notion" (icon with a "Z")
    - "Web Store" (icon with a rainbow)
    - "Add shortcut" (icon with a plus sign)

## Sidebar (Left Panel)

- **Application Icons**:
  - Activities (top-left)
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird (email client)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP (image editor)
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help (question mark)
  - Trash (recycle bin)
- **Bottom of Sidebar**: 
  - Grid icon (for application launcher)

## Bottom Right Corner

- **Customize Chrome Button**: 
  - Text: "Customise Chrome"
  - Icon: A pencil
  - Positioned in the bottom-right corner of the browser window

## Additional UI Elements

- **Memory Usage Indicator**: 
  - Displayed in the tab dropdown menu
  - Shows "Memory usage: 20.0 MB"
- **Google Apps Menu**: 
  - Located in the top-right corner
  - Includes "Gmail" and "Images" links
  - A 3x3 grid icon for accessing more Google services
